text:
A gas is stored in a container of constant volume.
The temperature of the gas is increased.
What happens to the particles of the gas?
A
The distance between the particles increases.
B
The mass of the particles increases.
C
The number of particles increases.
D
The speed of the particles increases.

options.label: A
options.text: The distance between the particles increases.

options.label: B
options.text: The mass of the particles increases.

options.label: D
options.text: The speed of the particles increases.

subject: Physics
